RequestId.description: Stable request id for support and retry diagnostics. Echoes `x-request-id` or `x-correlation-id` when supplied; otherwise generated by SPACE.

command.description: Non-empty argv with at most 4096 entries and 262144 aggregate UTF-8 bytes including separators. Arguments cannot contain NUL.

anyOf.description: Non-empty Linux guest path. Windows drive-letter and UNC paths are rejected.

env.description: Environment map with at most 256 entries and 65536 aggregate UTF-8 bytes across keys and values.

anyOf.description: Positive SPACE compact duration with at most nine integer digits. Units are seconds, minutes, hours, or days; the value must resolve to nanosecond precision.

timeout.description: Positive duration using SPACE compact syntax, such as `30s`, `5m`, or `1h`.

anyOf.description: Idle-lifecycle policy. Omit it to receive the server-side six-hour idle-to-suspend default, which access and command activity reset. An explicit policy, including a disabled one, is preserved.

env.description: Guest environment for the sandbox: at most 256 entries, keys of at most 128 and values of at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes, 65536 bytes in total, without NUL.

metadata.description: Caller-defined sandbox metadata: at most 64 entries, keys of at most 128 and string values of at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, 16384 bytes in total across keys and string values, without NUL.

name.description: Sandbox name of at most 256 UTF-8 bytes, without NUL.

anyOf.description: Sandbox egress policy override, applied on top of the template default.
Sandbox runtime. Prefer the canonical names; the short aliases are accepted for compatibility. Input enums are closed, so new runtimes are added additively.

template.description: Template reference as `name`, `name:tag`, or `name@sha256:<hex>`. A bare name resolves to `:latest`. A digest may be truncated to a unique prefix.

oneOf.description: A future server frame type not understood by this version of the client.

state.description: Extensible sandbox lifecycle state. Clients must accept values not listed in examples.

get.description: Returns the current state and result of an asynchronous operation owned by the authenticated organization.
Returns sandboxes ordered by creation time and ID, newest first.

parameters.description: Maximum number of sandboxes. Omitted or zero uses the server default of 100; values above 1000 are capped at 1000.
parameters.name: limit

post.description: Creates a sandbox asynchronously and returns an operation handle. The response reserves `sandbox_id`, but the sandbox row is written when the create operation executes, so `GET /sandboxes/{sandbox_id}` returns 404 until then; poll the operation rather than the sandbox to detect completion. When auto_lifecycle is omitted or null, the server applies a six-hour idle timeout whose action is suspend. Access and command activity reset the idle clock. An explicit policy object, including a disabled policy, is preserved.

schema.description: 1 to 1024 printable ASCII characters, spaces or tabs.

422.description: JSON body does not match CreateSandboxRequest

500.description: Sandbox operation could not be persisted

get.description: Process and file-watch sessions are supported. Send the scoped data-plane token using `Authorization: Bearer ...` or `Sec-WebSocket-Protocol`; query-string tokens are rejected. `Last-Event-ID` is accepted. Process streams replay from the bounded retained output window; file-watch streams and out-of-window process cursors emit `resync_required`. File-watch clients must re-list the watched path before trusting subsequent live events after `resync_required`.
